description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “Casa Luna”, a brand new coastal retreat in the heart of Panama City Beach designed for unforgettable beach vacations with family and friends. Spanning three spacious levels with elevator access throughout, this newly constructed 8-bedroom home offers the perfect blend of modern luxury, entertainment and relaxed Gulf Coast living. Wake up to breathtaking Gulf views from every level, spend sunny afternoons lounging by the private, heated pool and gather in thoughtfully designed living spaces made for connection and fun. Located directly across from the beach and moments from the area’s best dining, shopping and attractions, “Casa Luna” delivers the ultimate Panama City Beach getaway experience. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Brand new construction with thoughtfully designed luxury interiors and elevated coastal finishesStunning Gulf views from every level of the homePrivate, seasonally heated pool with expansive outdoor living spacesElevator access to all 3 floors for added convenienceSleeps 21 comfortably with 8 bedrooms and 8.5 bathroomsGame room with pool table, foosball, arcade machine and multiple entertainment spacesMultiple Gulf-view balconies perfect for morning coffee and sunset eveningsGourmet chef’s kitchen with spacious dining and gathering areasPutting green and cornhole boards for outdoor funLocated directly across from the beach with easy beach access*** LIVING AREAS ***“Casa Luna” was designed for gathering, entertaining and creating unforgettable vacation memories. The 1st-floor game room offers endless fun with multiple entertainment options and comfortable lounge seating, while the expansive 2nd-floor living area serves as the heart of the home with Gulf views, cozy seating and a welcoming atmosphere perfect for relaxing after beach days. Upstairs, an additional sitting area provides a peaceful retreat for quiet mornings or winding down in the evenings.1st-floor game room with pool table, foosball, arcade machine and flat-screen TVSpacious 2nd-floor living area with ample seating, electric fireplace and Gulf views3rd-floor sitting area with cozy seating, flat-screen TV and mini fridgeMultiple gathering spaces throughout the home perfect for large groups and families*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The chef-inspired kitchen on the 2nd floor is beautifully designed for everything from casual breakfasts to group dinners after a day at the beach. Featuring generous prep space, modern appliances and plenty of seating, this inviting space keeps everyone connected. A convenient kitchenette on the 1st floor adds additional flexibility for poolside snacks and entertaining.Chef’s kitchen with stainless steel appliances and ample counter spaceLarge island with bar seating for 5Dining area with seating for 101st-floor kitchenette with refrigerator, dishwasher and microwaveOpen layout ideal for entertaining and shared meals*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Step outside into your own private backyard retreat where sunny pool days, Gulf breezes and outdoor entertaining take center stage. Lounge by the pool, enjoy friendly competition on the putting green or gather for evening dinners fresh off the grill. Every outdoor space at “Casa Luna” is designed for effortless coastal living.Private, seasonally heated pool with pool loungers for relaxing in the sunSpacious pool deck with gas grill, outdoor sink and ice makerAl fresco dining area with seating for 6Putting green and cornhole boards for outdoor entertainmentExpansive Gulf-view balconies across multiple levels*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***With 8 bedrooms and 8.5 bathrooms spread across three thoughtfully designed levels, “Casa Luna” comfortably accommodates up to 21 guests while offering privacy and flexibility for families and groups.1st FloorKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in showerBunk Room: Two twin-over-twin bunk beds and flat-screen TVGuest Bathroom: Single vanity and shower/tub combo2nd FloorKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerBunk Room: Twin-over-twin bunk, twin-over-queen bunk, flat-screen TV and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in showerPowder Room: Conveniently located off the kitchen3rd FloorKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerRight Primary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in showerLeft Primary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerShared Gulf-view balcony connecting the primary suites*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Perfectly positioned on Front Beach Road, “Casa Luna” places you near some of Panama City Beach’s most popular attractions while still offering the relaxed atmosphere of a private coastal retreat. Spend your days enjoying the beach, shopping at Pier Park or exploring the scenic beauty of nearby 30A communities and state parks.Beach Access: Located directly across the street from the sugar-white sand and emerald Gulf watersPier Park: Premier destination for shopping, dining, nightlife, concerts and entertainmentCamp Helen State Park: Explore scenic hiking trails, kayaking, fishing and rare coastal dune lakesCarillon Beach: Nearby coastal community known for charming boutiques, dining and laid-back luxuryRosemary Beach & Inlet Beach: Easy drive to iconic 30A beach towns filled with upscale shopping and diningNorthwest Florida Beaches International Airport: Convenient nearby airport for easy travel access*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentPool is only heated between the dates of September 1st - April 30th.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A ESCAPES, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort, connection and unforgettable coastal memories*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***
